info.title: Smart Cinema Platform API
info.description: Phase 1. Admin bearer tokens require issuer/audience validation and server-enforced role/cinema scope. Times are UTC; input date filters are inclusive from and exclusive to.

code.description: Stable UI localization code. Optional for backward compatibility; clients fall back to HTTP status when absent.

managerId.description: Direct manager Keycloak ID. Active CINEMA_MANAGER in the same cinema; empty means unassigned.

phone.description: Vietnamese local or +84 format; separators spaces, parentheses, dot and dash allowed

transactionId.description: Optional Trans No: 6-10 digits, preserving leading zeroes (e.g. 01313035). Legacy /quantity suffixes of 3-5 digits are accepted and removed. Stored and returned IDs exclude ticket quantity. Empty or malformed input is omitted without blocking feedback.

transactionSource.description: Client-reported acquisition source, not proof of authenticity.

post.description: Multipart CSV/XLSX, 5 MB, 1000 data rows. Preview never writes. Confirm revalidates every row and imports currently valid rows transactionally. Headers: Staff Code, Full Name, Cinema Code, Manager Username. Optional Manager Username resolves to an active CINEMA_MANAGER in the same cinema and is revalidated on confirmation. Legacy three-column files remain supported. Rows include managerUsername and resolved managerId.
